elaine (AE): Quick update: Greenfield Capital wants to proceed with POC but legal pushed back on DPA + wants stronger SLA during pilot (99.95). They also requested PO workflow and an expedited signature path.
ravi (Legal): send redlines. any unusual asks?
mike (SE): They want to ensure KMS BYOK and log retention in EU. also asked whether Dedicated POC can have priority capacity guarantees.
toni (Procurement): they want invoice to go to AP@greenfield.cap and require PO number on invoice. Payment terms Net45. Also they added a clause to require Redwood to carry Cyber Liability insurance minimum $10M.
claire (Sales Ops): I'll prepare an order form template with PO field and invoice email. also adding an "expedite" toggle to route to legal-exec if PO received.
elaine (AE): they attached redlines: https://files.greenfield/redlines.pdf
ravi (Legal): scanning I see indemnity tweaks and cyber insurance ask. we typically accept $5M cyber. need to confirm with insurance broker.
mike (SE): Tech note I can paste:
```
- Private deployment: supported BYOK via customer HSM / KMS
- Hosted/dedicated: envelope encryption; dedicated KMS available as add-on
- Logs: configurable retention; EU retention can be enforced for customer-managed deployments
- Priority capacity: can offer reserved capacity at premium pricing for the POC window
```
toni (Procurement): Premium for reserved capacity = +40% of baseline monthly commit for duration. I'll confirm firm numbers by EOD.
claire (Sales Ops): esign-bot, create envelope GF-PO-1945678901 with PO field and reviewers ravi, toni, elaine.
esign-bot: envelope created GF-PO-1945678901. requirement: customer PO before countersign.
elaine (AE): ravi, can you propose compromise language on cyber insurance and indemnity by 5pm? we need to hit their 48h timeline.
ravi (Legal): will draft and propose adjustments. note: SCCs/DPA review may require Legal Ops if they insist on EU-specific clauses.
elaine (AE): thanks team. i'll push the customer for same-day PO after our call at 11am PT.
